product.description:
One useful place to start

Seventeen AI-assisted development references in one free download. Start with the CLAUDE.md templates and Claude Code Cheat Sheet, then explore the rest as you need it.

Inside the kit

  • CLAUDE.md Template Pack, Claude Code Cheat Sheet and Quick Reference Cards
  • The Agent Cookbook and AI Code Review Playbook
  • Hooks Library and Claude Code Hooks Deep Dive
  • Obsidian + Claude Code Setup Kit
  • MCP Server Starter Kit and Production MCP Server Kit
  • n8n AI Workflow Templates and Prompt Testing Framework
  • The Prompt Engineering OS (complete team reference edition)
  • Multi-Agent Orchestration Blueprint and Autonomous Agent Safety Patterns
  • Generative Art Starter Kit and Digital Product Launch Toolkit

Includes a two-page START-HERE.pdf, browser-readable contents and a file manifest. Enter your email to receive the download. No payment required.

These materials were assembled in March–April 2026. They are references, not verified current production integrations. Review code and current vendor documentation before installing hooks or running scripts. Original licenses are preserved.

Need help with private AI workflows? Explore Edgeless Lab private AI systems work.
